blocks.text: CNC PRESS BREAK
CNC Press Brake is used for precision bending of metal sheets and plates. It ensures consistency, accuracy, and repeatability in fabrication, making it ideal for structural components and enclosures.
MIG WELDING (FCAW)
MIG Welding (Metal Inert Gas) and FCAW (Flux Cored Arc Welding) provide strong, clean welds with high efficiency. Suitable for stainless steel, carbon steel, and aluminum in fabrication and repair.
TIG WELDING
TIG Welding (Tungsten Inert Gas) offers superior precision and clean welds, especially for thin materials and high-quality joints in stainless steel, aluminum, and exotic alloys.
ARC WELDING
ARC Welding (SMAW) is a versatile and cost-effective method for joining ferrous and non-ferrous metals. It is widely used in construction, pipelines, and structural fabrication.
SAW WELDING
Submerged Arc Welding (SAW) is used for high-deposition, heavy-duty applications. It provides deep penetration and strong welds for thick steel plates and large structures.
WELDER QUALIFIED AS PER ASME Sec IX
Our welders are qualified in accordance with ASME Section IX, ensuring adherence to international standards of welding quality, safety, and reliability for critical applications.
